maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: No, there have been no surveys in Nova Scotia.

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: Has any work been done on the Peel plain and the interlobate moraine in Ontario?

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: Not specifically, Mr. Chairman. At the present time we are endeavouring to train a competent staff, and probably next year we shall be asking for a bigger vote for this purpose. I hope the hon. member will remember it at that time.

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: I shall certainly support the minister. He mentioned somie areas in which there is already a shortage of ground water. Can he say where those areas are? I believe it is important, particularly in planning defence construction. If a defence plant were built in a district in which you are going to have a shortage of ground water, you are going to add a tremendous burden of expense in the operation of that plant, in connection with housing and other ancillary operations. Can the minister say where there is a shortage of ground water at the moment?

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: I am not prepared to say where there is a shortage. There is a special study being made of the Montreal area and the Ottawa area this year. The results are not yet known.

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: I should like to have a statement from the minister with respect to the enormous iron ore bodies in Labrador. I understand there is one survey party making an examination of those ore bodies. What progress has been made, and what progress has been made in surveying the enormous ore deposits at Steep Rock in western Ontario?

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: The department is making a study of the area, and making maps. We are working closely with the companies that are engaged in the development work there. The Ontario department of mines is carrying on a geological study of the Steep Rock area.

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: Where do the minister's department and staff co-ordinate or overlap with the provincial departments of mines? Most of the provinces have mining departments of their own. He states he works in co-ordination with them, but where does the primary responsibility rest?

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: That work is co-ordinated through committees that are set up. There is what is called a provincial mines ministers' conference. In some cases the provinces ask our department to make a general survey, and they carry out detailed studies of the ore bodies.

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: Has the minister's department made a complete survey showing the tonnage of iron ore in the Labrador area and in the Steep Rock deposits? Has there been an estimate of the tonnage in those respective districts?

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: This department does not carry out any drilling or any work that would prove up tonnages, but we do record the information that is gathered by the companies doing the development work.

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: What about the geophysical work that is carried out under this item? How many of these survey parties are conducting geophysical surveys? I mention this, Mr. Chairman, because the modern, method of prospecting is through the discovery of what are known as anomalies which are discovered by geophysical methods. They do not show that there is an ore body or they do not show that there is any particular type of ore there; but they certainly show that there is an alteration of the density of the rock underground and show a contact zone between the two different kinds of rocks which is generally a host condition to ore of various kinds. For instance, Lynn Lake I think was initially discovered almost entirely through geophysical methods. It is a method that is being perfected or is being largely developed by Canadian engineers and Canadian scientists. What are the department doing along geophysical lines and what are they doing with regard to geophysical work from the air?

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: We have only one airborne magnetometer. As to Lynn Lake, I think the hon. member is mistaken. That survey work was done by ground work.

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: Yes; but it was geophysical work.

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext:
We hope to have our airborne magnetometer wTorking in the eastern

townships this year. We still have to depend upon a supplementary estimate if we put it to work.

speechtext: I should like to ask the minister if he has any parties working on this work in Labrador this year.

minister anything in Labrador?

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: It is definitely known that in the lake Dubonnet, Bird river and Cat lake area, there are large deposits of minerals. I should like to ask the minister if he will investigate and have this matter brought to the attention of the officials during this coming year?

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext:
This is the topographical
survey as distinguished from the geological survey. This is the survey giving the physical outline of the country. I should like to know how much of the country is mapped. Therefore you map the
Northwest Territories through this survey?

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN

How far north have the
maps been completed so far?

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: You followed the Mackenzie river and other water courses. Have you plotted river basins and drainage areas or have you plotted the northern limit of trees and the northern limit of certain types of vegetation?

The whole area has been

speechtext:
Those are topographical
maps?

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext:
What is this
appropriation for? I cannot help noticing, and I suppose, other hon. members as well, that a great many votes are being asked for for construction or acquisition of new equipment. I mentioned one earlier. Just recently we called item 230, which had to do with the same subject, and hon. members on the other side of the house called "carried". I notice that some hon. members over there are more interested in having it carried than in obtaining information. I do not think anyone in the committee is disposed to hold up this minister's estimates, but when item 230 was carried it provided for $134,000 for the construction or acquisition of new equipment. The item which we have now called is for the construction . or acquisition of new equipment and the amount is $168,916. Down below we have another item, item 237, which is for construction or acquisition of new equipment, and the amount is $135,335. Will the minister give some explanation of these large expenditures following other expenditures and probably others in previous years? Where are these acquisitions stored? What does the total amount to? I assume a tabulation is produced each year and kept by the department, and an inventory is kept, and the material is properly looked after, and not left out in the weather as we have heard happens with machinery that is purchased in the western provinces. We have heard complaints that farm machinery is purchased out there and allowed to be exposed to the weather and deteriorate. Can the minister give the committee some information?

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext:
The item of construction and acquisition of new equipment is charged to each branch in the department, each being a separate item. This particular item, 232, has to do with Canadian hydrographic service. This vote is to provide mainly for the acquisition of equipment required for the charting of Canadian coastal and inland navigable waters, the investigation of tides and currents, and the preparation of plans and specifications for a new hydrographic ship for northern waters.
We had that item in the estimates this year, a vote of some two million dollars for a new ship which is very badly needed, but in the interests of economy we were asked to take it out of the estimates. We did. An item was left in the estimates for the preparation of the plans for that ship so that we can proceed when the money is available.

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN

This vote is for legal surveys and aeronautical charts, including a grant of $350 to assist in printing the publication of the Canadian Institute of Surveying and Photogrammetry and $4,250 to cover the fees and other expenses of the board of examiners for dominion land surveyors.
The purpose of this vote is to maintain the legal surveys and aeronautical charts division which undertakes all legal surveys of crown lands in the Yukon and Northwest Territories, of national parks, and Indian reserves, and legal surveys required by the departments of the government of Canada; the preparation of electoral district maps; the plotting, preparing and maintenance of aeronautical charts of all kinds for civil and military purposes; the preparation of air flight manuals; the maintenance of a central distributing agency for charts, maps, plans and technical publications, and the maintenance of the central office for indexing, filing and recording survey returns and plans and supplying information from them. This vote also includes provision for the fees and expenses of the board of examiners for dominion land surveyors. In previous years this was a separate vote.

speechtext: We have the same item here again. What is it for? The minister did not answer my last question. What becomes of the machinery after it is acquired by the department from year to year? Is it kept under proper care and is an inventory taken from year to year? I am not going into what has been voted Under this item in previous years as it runs into enormous sums for the acquisition of machinery, and so on.

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext:
Because of national defence requirements and a general increase in our survey program, there has been an enormous increase in our mapping programs. This
Supply-Mines and Technical Surveys vote provides for the acquisition of map reproduction equipment. Because existing government map producing plants have proved to be inadequate in keeping pace with the demand for maps for civil and military purposes, and because they lack the facilities to produce the type of maps required today, consideration has been given to setting up a modern map production unit to handle all government map printing. With this end in view, the services of an independent expert on map printing were retained to make a survey of existing facilities and to make recommendations for an adequate plant. His report has been received and in it he recommends the equipment which should be acquired to bring about the desired improvement in map reproduction. The amount submitted in this vote is for the purchase of this new equipment.
I can assure the hon. gentleman that this equipment is well cared for. It is kept in central warehouses in various areas where it can best be distributed to the survey parties in the field.

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: What is the total investment in machinery and equipment under this heading?

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: I am sorry, but we have not a complete up-to-date inventory.

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext:
Are there any signs of large developments in the coal-mining area west of Okotoks and High River in the Priddis area, and south in Alberta? I am not asking that developments be carried on there because I know that a strip mine is turning out fairly good coal, but I do believe the possible development of this area has been somewhat over-expressed. The story has gone out that great things are about to happen in that area and I should like the minister to tell us

Supply-Mines and Technical Surveys if that is so. I am inclined to think that that expectation is without very much hope.
People have been induced to invest money when perhaps the investment will not be to their benefit, at least for a long time. I do not know whether the minister has any information, but I think it is important that people should know whether they can expect any great developments if they invest their money. I recall two years ago a man came to me and said that a railroad was to be built into this area within sixty days. I said, "I am not a betting man, but I do not like the truth to be misrepresented. I am willing to bet you $100 that there will not be a tie or piece of machinery in there within the next six months, let alone the next sixty days". He said he had inside information. I said, "I do not care what information you have, put up your hundred bucks". He did not put up his hundred bucks, but I happen to know that others did put money in and, I am afraid, lost it. That is why I am asking the minister if he can state whether there is any expectation of great commercial development in that area.

speakerposition: Minister of Mines and Technical Surveys
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: I have no information and I do not know of any prospective development.

speakerposition: Deputy Chair of Committees of the Whole
maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext: Shall the item carry?

maintopic: THE UKRAINIAN CATHOLIC EPISCOPAL CORPORATION OF SASKATCHEWAN
speechtext:
I think we have made pretty good progress. This item is of importance to all Canada and I do not think we should rush it through. I have no criticism to offer of the work done by this board over the years; on the contrary, I pay it a great tribute for the work it has done in connection with the development of our coal areas.
Item stands.
Progress reported.
